author: adamb231986
quote: It breaks my heart that such a great has been utterly destroyed. Characters are boring and dull, storyline feels like it was created by woke LGBTQ+ diversity hires, 13 years to wait for 30FPS, buggy as hell. I played 2 hours and requested a refund. Enough is enough. They took a game that was amazing and made it into serving a woman with anger issues. Unbelievable. The graphics are nice, but not that much nicer than the previous GTA. Bottom line, not worth the money for me. I think its time we teach these companies that all the woke, feminist, political nonsense, has no place in a game. I hate Rockstar for ruining my favorite game of all time.
